agent.problem: The blank asks for Adar, but no earlier card gives any clue to the month. A baker using only the earlier cards can select it only by luck, so the blank tests unseen wording rather than a meaning the baker can reason out.

rule.text: The blank tests meaning the baker can reason out, not wording they haven't seen.

agent.problem: Esther 9:30 is covered only by denying that the letters contain warning and threat. Even when the baker correctly selects False, neither this card nor any later card supplies the actual detail that Mordecai sent words of peace and truth.

rule.text: When the baker leaves Prep, they understand the whole passage without missing an important detail.
